concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-pix-web-component]] — 2026-09-15-captured Pix Web Components Sessions/Advanced guide for QR display/action, flow-specific fields/expiry, refund timing and asynchronous test/live status.
warnings: Sessions shopperStatement maximum is 140 characters, while Advanced says a supplied value must be under 60; retain flow scope.
Component countdownTime defaults to 15 minutes after QR load, while Advanced sessionValidity defaults to one or 24 hours by Checkout API version; do not equate the timers.
Captured Sessions and Advanced examples contain expired 2021/2025 sessionValidity values; they are not copy-ready current expiry settings.
